intent_snapshot.goal: unified-lane-sessions S3 (#570; Spec docs/specs/unified-lane-sessions.spec.md D2 transitional, D3, D4, D12 rebind proof, D17, OD-15, BR-DEC-2, BR-DEC-4, BR-DEC-5). First prove on a two-child Initiative fixture that record-level rebindBatchChildIdentity (generalized from rebindSingleTaskIdentity) appends a contiguous lane_rebinds entry for any child, and that hasContiguousLaneRebind and batch_git.ts final verification keep the pre-rebind Parent identity; if that cannot hold, stop for re-planning before any later Slice relies on the v3 shape. Then export BatchAgreement + authorizeBatch (confirmation, final_verification { required, commands }, return_policy checkout_delivery | retain_branch, interaction_mode interactive_host | parent_relayed) from runtime/unattended/batch_agreement.ts; write Lane records as batch_run_state/v3 carrying agreement policies, batch-level session_provider and per-child session (both null until S4), and per-child lane_removed / lane_retained / lane_rebinds; refuse v2 with batch_record_retired; decide completion by final_verification and coordinator return by return_policy, removing plan_source from batch_lanes.ts, batch_git.ts, lane_cleanup.ts, and assurance/run_continuation.ts; migrate the stored-record contract assertions of existing suites from v2 to v3; keep startBatch as a transitional adapter.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/batch-agreement.test.ts and tests/batch-completion-verifier.test.ts: on a two-child Initiative v3 record, rebindBatchChildIdentity for Child 2 appends exactly one contiguous lane_rebinds entry naming Child 2's task_id, from_digest, and to_digest and advances plan_digest while Child 1's record is byte-identical; a stale from_digest is refused with no write; after the rebind, Parent final verification in batch_git.ts passes under the Parent identity established before the rebind.

In tests/claude-run-continuation.test.ts: hasContiguousLaneRebind accepts a contiguous lane_rebinds chain for an Initiative child and for a single task, and refuses a chain with a gap, a foreign task_id, or a target digest off the chain (negative controls).

In tests/batch-agreement.test.ts: authorizeBatch produces valid agreements for Host (native_gate, checkout_delivery or retain_branch, interactive_host) and daemon (policy_auto or tracker_approval, LOOP_DAEMON_ACTOR_ID, retain_branch, parent_relayed) accepted by the batch authority registry; unknown confirmation.source, return_policy, interaction_mode, or non-array final_verification.commands each return batch_agreement_invalid and write zero files.

In tests/batch-agreement.test.ts and tests/batch-completion-verifier.test.ts: completion is decided by final_verification.required (false completes on delivery; true requires passing commands) and coordinator return follows return_policy (checkout_delivery stages delta; retain_branch keeps refs/heads/imm/<slug>) for both 1-child and 2-child agreements.

In tests/unattended-batch-lanes.test.ts and tests/single-task-lane-batch.test.ts: new Lane batch records carry assurance_kernel/batch_run_state/v3 with agreement policies, session_provider null, and every children[].session null; stored v2 Lane records are refused with batch_record_retired naming retire_stale_batch; v1 records still read.

batch_lanes.ts, batch_git.ts, lane_cleanup.ts, and assurance/run_continuation.ts never mention plan_source, and tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts enforces that rule for those files and proves runtime/unattended/ imports neither runtime/session/ nor runtime/lane_sessions/.

Transitional startBatch-based Host and daemon callers pass their existing focused suites; the only assertion changes are stored-record contract expectations moved from assurance_kernel/batch_run_state/v2 to v3 (tests/claude-batch-authority.test.ts:160,528; tests/batch-stale-disposition.test.ts:45,207,461; and any other stored v2 Lane fixture in these suites), with no assertion removed or weakened.
Claude bundle, Antigravity artifact, dist reference mirrors, and repository typecheck are current.

intent_snapshot.scope_size_reason: The v3 record contract, the Initiative rebind it must carry, and the suites that persist Lane records change atomically: v2 records fail closed as soon as v3 is written, so every stored-record fixture moves in the same Slice. The session port and reconciler moved to S4 so this Slice holds only the agreement and record contract.

Blast radius: tier low for this delta (test-only); overall medium, centred on batch_lanes.ts/batch_state.ts persisted v3 record shape.

findings.summary: runLaneBatch never writes agreement policies into new Lane records, and the named suites assert none of the A5 record facts

evidence.trigger: Any Host/daemon startBatch → runLaneBatch creating a fresh record (batch_lanes.ts:1016-1034 calls prepareBatchLaneRunState without confirmation/return_policy/interaction_mode/final_verification_required) → persisted v3 record carries no agreement policies, contrary to 'new Lane batch records carry v3 with agreement policies'; tests/unattended-batch-lanes.test.ts and tests/single-task-lane-batch.test.ts only rename v2→v3 and never assert policies, session_provider null, children[].session null, or v2 refusal with batch_record_retired naming retire_stale_batch

findings.summary: Completion-by-required and return-by-policy runtime behavior is untested for 1- and 2-child agreements

evidence.trigger: tests/batch-agreement.test.ts AGR-A4 only calls prepareBatchLaneRunState and effectiveReturnPolicy on in-memory records → no assertion that final_verification_required false completes on delivery in observeParentCompletion (batch_git.ts:1058-1062), that required true needs passing commands, that checkout_delivery stages the delta (new 2-child branch batch_lanes.ts:1499-1510 deliverSingleTask from record.base_head), or that retain_branch keeps refs/heads/imm/<slug>; tests/batch-completion-verifier.test.ts changes only contract strings

findings.summary: hasContiguousLaneRebind negative controls and Initiative-child case are absent from tests/claude-run-continuation.test.ts

evidence.trigger: tests/claude-run-continuation.test.ts is unchanged in the revision → no test of a chain with a gap, a foreign task_id (the new childIds guard in run_continuation.ts:hasContiguousLaneRebind), or a target digest off the chain, and no Initiative-child (non-single_task) acceptance; a regression removing the foreign-task_id guard passes all delivered tests

findings.summary: Post-rebind Parent final verification under the pre-rebind identity is never exercised

evidence.trigger: tests/batch-agreement.test.ts AGR-A1 stops after hasContiguousLaneRebind and the stale-refusal check; neither it nor tests/batch-completion-verifier.test.ts (contract rename only) runs Parent final verification in batch_git.ts after rebindBatchChildIdentity advances plan_digest → the clause 'Parent final verification passes under the Parent identity established before the rebind' has no asserting test

findings.summary: The 'coordinator return follows return_policy' half of AGR-A4 is never tested through the runtime. The new 2-child checkout_delivery branch in runLaneBatch (deliverSingleTask from record.base_head, needs_human park with no cleanup) runs in no test. The AGR-A4 runtime tests call deliverSingleTask by hand, and no test asserts that retain_branch keeps refs/heads/imm/<slug>.

evidence.trigger: A 2-child v3 record with return_policy checkout_delivery whose children are all integrated reaches the new else-branch of the isCheckout block in runLaneBatch. tests/batch-agreement.test.ts 'AGR-A4 runtime' only writes a completed record, checks observeParentCompletion, and then calls deliverSingleTask(root, main, head) itself. A change that sent checkout_delivery records through returnBatchToCoordinator, skipped staging the delta for 2 children, or deleted refs/heads/imm/<slug> under retain_branch would still pass every AGR-A4 test. Wrong result: return-policy routing for 1- and 2-child agreements goes out unproven, and the new multi-child checkout path is untested.
